draw: census: all 85 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: Canonicalization rule: serialize the proposal artifact as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace, then persist the exact bytes hashed as proposal_canon.json in the run scratch dir; re-derive seed by computing h = SHA-256(proposal_canon.json) and then computing seed = SHA-256(hProposal + salt) using the instance-provided mode inputs (salt and hProposal), verifying mechanically that sha256sum proposal_canon.json reproduces the same intermediate hash h, and that the computed seed matches seedHex; witnesses are then drawn deterministically without replacement by the stated census rule: census: all 85 witnesses of census.json, in order.
